title: ISRO SDSC SHAR Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 400 Apprenticeship Posts
description: Satish Dhawan Space Centre SHAR (ISRO SDSC SHAR) has announced the official notification for 2026. It is to fill vacancies for 04 Graduate Apprentice, Technician Apprentice, and Trade Apprentice Jobs. Candidates who have qualified with 10th Pass, ITI, Any Degree, Diploma, or B.E/ B.Tech in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering can take advantage of this opportunity and apply for the ISRO SDSC SHAR Notification 2026 .
